catalog.title: OptVec campaign
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Operation report and its provenance; inspect the declared run/config output.
catalog.restriction: Explicit config, reviewed input hashes and a fresh engine plan are required. GPU work requires immutable model revisions. Outputs are new records; local/Slurm execution uses the existing scientific owner. Native MLX numerical equivalence is not claimed. Remote training and analysis outputs are retained; the diagnostic cleanup policy does not authorize their removal. The first job materializes the campaign only. Cell submission and monitoring remain separate campaign operations. Use action status/plan with an empty body. Submit/cancel require the reviewed planSHA256 and confirmAction true. This performs one explicit queue top-up, never an unattended submission loop. After all cells finish, the ordinary science-export/fetch path captures the campaign and nested cell outputs.
